name: pucp.edu.pe
body: Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: www.pucp.edu.pe scores 49 out of 100 (F). 10 checks fail now, 36 are at risk, and 34 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 18 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /la-universidad/directorio-de-unidades/, /la-universidad/directorio-de-servicios/, /la-universidad/herramientas-informaticas/, /la-universidad/nuestra-universidad/mision-vision-y-valores/ and 9 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, /admision/admision-pregrado/modalidades-de-admision/, /la-universidad/directorio-de-unidades/, for example .nav-pills > li[role="menuitem"]:nth-child(1) and .nav-pills > li[role="menuitem"]:nth-child(2). Impact:…

fix.title: The TLS certificate expires in 13 days
fix.evidence: Valid until 2026-11-08, issued by Sectigo Limited.
fix.fix: Renew now and check that automatic renewal works.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (7 requests), Microsoft Clarity (5 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), and cookies __Secure-YNID on youtube.com, YSC on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.
